data.name: Summon Nature's Ally
data.description: You can cast summon nature's ally %1 as a spell-like ability %2 times per day as a standard action and the creatures remain for %3 minutes (instead of %3 rounds). Drawing upon this ability uses up the same power you use to call your eidolon. As a result, you can only use this ability when your eidolon is not summoned.|SummonMonsterLVL|SummonMonsterTimes|SummonMonsterDuration
